lvars._comment: Shared Fenix A32x FCU annunciator and parking-brake readbacks. The trusted fenix-a32x adapter owns the larger aircraft-specific field and action surface.

controls._comment: Aircraft-specific cockpit writes are selected only from the trusted fenix-a32x adapter. Persistent switches/selectors retain fixed targets and exact readback. The reviewed FCU subset adds bounded MobiFlight-only press/release pulses, managed push/pull commands, and stepped speed/heading/altitude targets. Four paired forward-throttle detents set and independently confirm both levers; reverse thrust and arbitrary axis values remain excluded along with unrelated momentary, guarded emergency, breaker, maintenance, preset, and macro controls. Standard gear/flap actions remain available on the narrow shared surface.

meta.notes: Shared trusted integration for the Fenix A319, A320, and A321. The adapter exposes 139 live fields, 318 trusted actions, and 138 action-confirmation fields across persistent exterior/cockpit lighting, cabin, electrical, fuel, pneumatic, hydraulic, ADIRS, EFIS, switching, radio, weather-radar, transponder, brake, engine-mode, GPWS, the reviewed FCU subset, and four paired forward-throttle detents. Every write is cooldown-guarded, never retries automatically, and requires exact logical readback.

sources.name: MSFS radio events and transponder state
sources.notes: Defines XPNDR_SET BCO16 encoding and TRANSPONDER CODE:1 / TRANSPONDER STATE:1 state. Aircraft compatibility is reviewed separately against the original integrations cited in docs/ATC-EFIS-AIRCRAFT-COVERAGE.md. Squawk writes require fresh powered state and a newer selected-code readback. IDENT uses the aircraft button, not a generic IDENT event.

sources.name: Original Fenix selected-squawk integration
sources.notes: Uses XPNDR_SET and formats N_FREQ_XPDR_SELECTED as a four-digit decimal code. The symbol is also present in the installed FenixSystem.exe and FenixDisplay.exe. Read-only code observation is used; this output variable is never written. No source code is copied.

sources.name: FenixSim Support Hub - binding switches, knobs and buttons
sources.notes: Fenix identifies its shipped Cockpit_Behavior.xml and interaction templates as the authoritative LVar/control source and publicly demonstrates fixed 0/1 writes plus bounded A_*_LIGHTING values. The adapter's I_FCU_*, N_FCU_*, S_*, E_FCU_*, and A_* fields, raw detents, and fixed or bounded write recipes were reviewed against licensed Fenix A320 MSFS 2024 package version 2.4.0.4720: the legacy cockpit file, modular panel *Behavior.xml files, and FNX32X interaction templates. The reviewed FCU contract uses stable I_FCU_AP1/AP2/ATHR/LOC/APPR/EXPED readback for paired S_FCU_* press/release counter increments; I_FCU_SPEED/HEADING/ALTITUDE_MANAGED for S_FCU_SPEED/HEADING/ALTITUDE push (decrement) and pull (increment); and fresh N_FCU_SPEED/HEADING/ALTITUDE baselines for bounded repeated E_FCU_SPEED/HEADING/ALTITUDE increments or decrements. The reviewed throttle template maps A_FC_THROTTLE_LEFT_INPUT and A_FC_THROTTLE_RIGHT_INPUT values 2, 3, 4, and 5 to IDLE, CLB, FLX/MCT, and TOGA; Flight Fabric writes both together and confirms both separately. Reverse positions and continuous axis control are excluded. N_FCU_VS is display-only because its raw value does not identify VS versus FPA mode. S_MIP_PARKING_BRAKE uses 0=released and 1=set; S_FCU_EFIS*_BARO_MODE uses 0=INHG and 1=HPA; S_FCU_ALTITUDE_SCALE uses 0=1000 ft and 1=100 ft. APU START source review 2026-09-06, installed Fenix A320 2.4.0.4720: Cockpit_Behavior.xml APU component names S_OH_ELEC_APU_START and FNX32X_Interact_Button_Momentary_Template. The shipped Interactions.xml increments that counter on both LeftSingle and LeftRelease. START uses the existing bounded 100 ms calculator press/release pattern and transport acknowledgement; it never assigns a fixed 0/1 to the counter. The master remains S_OH_ELEC_APU_MASTER=1 with short control readback. No starting/available status is inferred from annunciator brightness or the input counter. ATC/EFIS review 2026-09-07: the installed Cockpit_Behavior.xml defines S_FCU_EFIS1_ND_ZOOM and S_FCU_EFIS2_ND_ZOOM (0..5), S_FCU_EFIS1_LS / S_FCU_EFIS2_LS momentary counters and I_FCU_EFIS1_LS / I_FCU_EFIS2_LS lamp readbacks. S_XPDR_IDENT is a momentary counter; B_PED_XPDR is the transponder display power input. Interactions.xml maps S_FC_FLAPS to UP/1/2/3/FULL. N_FREQ_XPDR_SELECTED is an installed FenixSystem.exe and FenixDisplay.exe symbol; the separately cited original integration establishes its decimal selected-squawk interpretation. These outputs are read only. Approach-control review 2026-09-07 against installed 2.4.0.4720 Cockpit_Behavior.xml and Interactions.xml: S_FC_FLAPS 0..4 selects UP/1/2/3/FULL; A_FC_SPEEDBRAKE 0=ARM, 1=RETRACT, 2=HALF, 3=FULL. S_MIP_AUTOBRAKE_LO, S_MIP_AUTOBRAKE_MED and S_MIP_AUTOBRAKE_MAX increment on press and release; separate I_MIP_AUTOBRAKE_LO_L, I_MIP_AUTOBRAKE_MED_L and I_MIP_AUTOBRAKE_MAX_L mode lamps confirm all three target states. OFF freezes the selected button before one pulse and rejects stale or inconsistent lamps. See docs/APPROACH-CONTROLS-AIRCRAFT-COVERAGE.md; live validation is pending. Barometer review 2026-09-07 against installed Cockpit_Behavior.xml, Interactions.xml and Inputs.xml: S_FCU_EFIS1_BARO_STD and S_FCU_EFIS2_BARO_STD decrement on PUSH (QNH), increment on PULL (STD); these are push/pull counters, without a press/release pair. E_FCU_EFIS1_BARO and E_FCU_EFIS2_BARO increment/decrement by one per pressure detent. S_FCU_EFIS1_BARO_MODE and S_FCU_EFIS2_BARO_MODE select 0=INHG / 1=HPA. B_FCU_POWER gates I_FCU_EFIS1_QNH and I_FCU_EFIS2_QNH (0=STD, 1=QNH); N_FCU_EFIS1_BARO_HPA, N_FCU_EFIS2_BARO_HPA, N_FCU_EFIS1_BARO_INCH and N_FCU_EFIS2_BARO_INCH provide selected pressure. All output symbols were verified in installed FenixSystem.exe; numeric/indicator interpretation is corroborated by the separately cited original integration. Every selected side requires independently fresh mode, units and pressure; see docs/BARO-CONTROLS.md. FCU review 2026-09-10: installed Cockpit_Behavior.xml confirms E_FCU_VS rotary counters and S_FCU_ALTITUDE_SCALE (1=100ft). Installed Fenix.exe contains the independent mode symbols B_FCU_SPEED_MACH and B_FCU_TRACK_FPA_MODE. These read-only booleans guard Mach and VS/FPA target units. Ordinary altitude requests establish and confirm hundred-foot scale before rotating. Unexpected numeric encodings fail closed. These added mode/target contracts still require live variant validation; see docs/AUTOPILOT-TARGET-VALIDATION.md. Lighting review 2026-09-10: shipped Cockpit_Behavior.xml and FNX32X_Interact_Knob_Increment_Lock_Template establish direct writable 0..1 dimmers A_DISPLAY_BRIGHTNESS_CO, A_DISPLAY_BRIGHTNESS_CI, A_DISPLAY_BRIGHTNESS_CI_OUTER, A_DISPLAY_BRIGHTNESS_FO, A_DISPLAY_BRIGHTNESS_FI, A_DISPLAY_BRIGHTNESS_FI_OUTER, A_DISPLAY_BRIGHTNESS_ECAM_U, A_DISPLAY_BRIGHTNESS_ECAM_L; A_FCU_LIGHTING, A_FCU_LIGHTING_TEXT, A_OH_LIGHTING_OVD, A_PED_LIGHTING_PEDESTAL, A_MIP_LIGHTING_FLOOD_MAIN, A_MIP_LIGHTING_FLOOD_PEDESTAL, A_MIP_LIGHTING_MAP_L and A_MIP_LIGHTING_MAP_R. Percentage presets require independent fresh knob readback; live validation remains pending. See docs/COCKPIT-LIGHTING-VALIDATION.md.

sources.name: Fenix A319 and A321 Expansion
sources.notes: Confirms the supported A319 and A321 family variants and their shared family development baseline. Variant-only controls still fail closed when their live LVar is unavailable; the page hides A319/A320 center-pump and pack-flow controls on A321 and shows the ACT control only on A321.

sources.name: Fenix A320 V2 Block 2 release
sources.notes: Documents Fenix's expanded hardware LVar and internal input-event work. This adapter uses only source-audited persistent or bounded LVar counter contracts and does not assume custom InputEvents are executable.

sources.name: MSFS 2024 SimConnect Input Events
sources.notes: Documents native Input Event discovery/read/write support. The adapter can add proven Input Event routes later; current Fenix writes use its vendor-documented LVar interaction contract.

knownIssues: The expanded write routes were audited against a current licensed A320 package but still require live in-simulator validation before being promoted from untested.
A319 and A321 matching and common/variant LVar compatibility require live validation with the expansion installed.
The A321 uses ECON FLOW in place of the A319/A320 pack-flow selector; the shared template hides the A319/A320 pack-flow readout for the A321 profile.
The new AP1/AP2, A/THR, LOC, APPR, EXPED, managed push/pull, and speed/heading/altitude target actions are source-audited but remain untested in the live aircraft.
The paired IDLE, CLB, FLX/MCT, and TOGA throttle targets are source-audited and backend-tested but remain untested in the live aircraft; reverse thrust and arbitrary axis values are excluded.

A numeric FCU target can require hundreds of calculator increments from a fresh baseline. The bounded route stops on the first failed acknowledgement or profile-generation change and never retries, so an interrupted sequence can leave an intermediate target.
N_FCU_VS is exposed for display only; no vertical target action is enabled because the raw value is ambiguous between VS and FPA mode.
Logical readback proves the vendor LVar reached its fixed target; it does not independently prove every downstream aircraft-system effect.

Start APU UI and voice preset is source-backed and covered by automated transport tests; live start, electrical prerequisites, selector release and aircraft variant/build coverage remain untested. See docs/APU-START-VALIDATION.md.
